text: In the wild, there is no creature more hardworking than the contractor.
At dawn, the crew gathers. Six workers. Three job sites. And one very old question.
Traditionally, the answer lives in the notebook. A fragile creature of its own. Rained on. Coffee stained. Quietly judged by everyone.
By Friday, the contractor must turn it all into timesheets. A ritual that consumes the entire evening.
But now, something new has appeared on the site. Constra.
Watch closely. The crew clocks in with a photo and G P S, and the map lights up, job by job.
The hours add themselves up. Overtime is worked out, automatically.
And the timesheet, once a week of effort, becomes a single click. P D F, or Excel.
Estimates. Invoices. R F Is. Change orders. Daily reports. Twenty-six tools in all, plus twenty-three Excel templates.
And when the signal drops? It carries on. Quietly. Patiently. Exactly as nature intended.
The result is a rare sight. A contractor, home for dinner.
Constra. Free while it's launching. Run the job, not the paperwork.
